resources.string: The capacity applies only to disposable previews, not full history. Clear removes offline history, previews and inactive temporary files. Remote history, hosts and login details stay unchanged. Active processing data is retained until processing finishes; small database and index files may remain.

This removes offline history, conversation previews and inactive temporary files from this device. Remote history, saved hosts and login details are not changed. Data used by ongoing processing stays until processing finishes. Small database and index files may remain.
